summary: Electrovaya Inc. filed a Form 6-K on October 8, 2026, furnishing two consent exhibits: the consent of Canadian counsel Fasken Martineau DuMoulin LLP and the consent of independent auditor MNP LLP, each referencing a prospectus supplement dated October 8, 2026 that forms part of the company's Form F-10 registration statement (File No. 333-299298), a US-equivalent shelf registration. No securities were sold, no price, stake, premium or closing date is stated, and no board recommendation or advisor engagement appears. This is a routine shelf-related consent filing, not a special situation; monitor any subsequent prospectus supplement pricing for actual capital-raising terms.
